About the show

Back by Huge Public Demand! Rollers Forever is the smash-hit tartan-clad musical celebrating the music, memories and passionate fandom of the Bay City Rollers. This warm and funny story follows two lifelong friends who reconnect on a Saturday night and are pulled back into the excitement...

Concessions at Pavilion Theatre

Concessions are set per show and applied at the point of purchase. Access tickets, including companion seats, are arranged with the theatre directly rather than online.

Concession

Where a show offers one. Must be claimed at the time of purchase — it cannot be added afterwards — and proof of entitlement may be asked for. Only one discount applies per ticket; where several would, you get the cheapest single one.

Access and companion tickets

Wheelchair spaces and essential companion tickets are booked by phone, in person, or through the theatre's enquiry form.

Fees

Some events include a venue levy of up to £2 in the ticket price.
